verdict.rationale: Vue's docs claim a "truly reactive, compiler-optimized rendering system that rarely requires manual optimization" (vue-docs-4). Community users praise its ergonomic reactive component-state API (vue-comm-2, vue-comm-18), which together cover the core of declaring reactive state that drives UI updates. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that dependency tracking re-runs only the dependent code, no in-depth first-party docs on the reactivity APIs, no hands-on corroboration of update granularity.
